mapper.select: select t.orgid,o.orgname from ( select p.unit as orgid from TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN_RISK r left join TBL_RISK_RISKMARKING a on a.assriskid=r.assriskid left join TBL_RISK_ASSPLAN p on p.assplanid=r.assplanid where p.unit is not null and a.asssatus=2 group by p.unit ) t left join TBL_ORGANIZATION o on o.orgid=t.orgid
select t.orgid,o.orgname from (select unit as orgid from TBL_RISK group by unit) t left join tbl_organization o on o.orgid=t.orgid
